name: Build Release APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Set up Gradle 8.9
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.9

      - name: Build unsigned release APK
        run: gradle :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - name: Prepare keystore
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.jks"
            echo "KS_PASS=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "KS_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "KS_KEY_PASS=${KEY_PASSWORD:-$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            echo "No keystore secrets found. Generating a temporary keystore."
            keytool -genkeypair -v \
              -keystore "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.jks" \
              -alias awv -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \
              -storepass awvtemp123 -keypass awvtemp123 \
              -dname "CN=AWV Browser, O=AWV, C=LK"
            echo "KS_PASS=awvtemp123" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "KS_ALIAS=awv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "KS_KEY_PASS=awvtemp123" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          echo "KS_FILE=$RUNNER_TEMP/release.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Align and sign APK
        run: |
          BT="$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/$(ls "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" | sort -V | tail -1)"
          IN=$(ls app/build/outputs/apk/release/*-unsigned.apk | head -1)
          mkdir -p out
          "$BT/zipalign" -f -p 4 "$IN" out/aligned.apk
          "$BT/apksigner" sign \
            --ks "$KS_FILE" \
            --ks-key-alias "$KS_ALIAS" \
            --ks-pass "pass:$KS_PASS" \
            --key-pass "pass:$KS_KEY_PASS" \
            --out out/AWV-Browser-release.apk \
            out/aligned.apk
          "$BT/apksigner" verify --verbose out/AWV-Browser-release.apk

      - name: Upload release APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: AWV-Browser-release
          path: out/AWV-Browser-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Publish GitHub Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: out/AWV-Browser-release.apk
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
